name: jantcz
description: Tools for coding agents by Jan Truhlar: Claude Code and Codex plugins.

plugins.name: cli-kanban
plugins.description: A kanban board of Markdown files in your repository: a skill for the agent and an MCP server to move tickets.

plugins.name: cli-test-summary
plugins.description: Run the project's tests and get one JSON answer: counts and every failure with file, line and message; failures re-run alone to tell real from flaky.

plugins.name: cli-transcriber
plugins.description: Skills and agents written once as YAML with shared partials: a skill that keeps the agent editing the sources, and a hook that stops edits to the generated files.
